title: Nashvilla
meta_description: Inside a tranquil, gated community lies Nashvilla, a luxe, 4-bedroom oasis that’s as welcoming and laid-back as the town it’s named after. Featuring a private pool and a flawless location that keeps you close to the beaches, Nashvilla has space for ten.
description_expanded: DescriptionNestled in the serene Gulf Coast region, Longue Vue is a prestigious, gated enclave perfectly situated between the quaint Rosemary Beach and the stunning Alys Beach. Within this sought-after locale, you'll discover Nashvilla, a luxurious four-bedroom haven that embodies the relaxed charm of its Nashville-inspired moniker. This home boasts a private swimming pool and an unbeatable location that offers easy access to both the beach and a variety of local attractions, providing ample space for twelve guests along with convenient parking options.The property greets you with its traditional charm, featuring mature tropical plants and a decorative stone driveway leading to the welcoming entrance. The foyer serves as a practical space to leave beachwear after a day by the sea. On the ground level, you'll find three tranquil bedrooms: a secluded guest suite with a king-sized bed and a private bathroom, another room with a twin bed and trundle, and a bunk room equipped with two sets of twin bunk beds. This floor also houses another bathroom and a laundry room for added convenience.Ascending to the second floor, you're welcomed into a spacious great room that combines living, dining, and kitchen areas into an open and airy space. The living area offers comfortable seating with a sleeper sofa, perfect for movie nights or engaging in lively games, while the dining area accommodates eight guests with an adjacent coffee bar. The kitchen shines with bright white cabinetry, quartz countertops, and top-notch appliances, including an additional refrigerator in the laundry room for extra convenience.The primary bedroom suite on this floor is a luxurious retreat with a king-size bed, balcony access, and a private bathroom featuring a double vanity and a walk-in shower. An additional bathroom serves the common areas on this level.Nashvilla's prime location ensures you're just a short walk from the beach, while the home's backyard oasis features a stunning swimming pool and spa, complemented by various lounging and dining options. Close to renowned golf courses, exquisite dining, and entertainment, Nashvilla offers an ideal setting for a memorable family vacation.Home Highlights:* Private Neighborhood Beach Access* Gated one street neighborhood* Professionally designed interior with recent updates in 2022* Private, optionally heated pool (Pool heat may be added for $45/day plus tax)* Open and spacious layout* Modern amenities, including a washer, dryer, and 4 complimentary beach cruiser bikes* Close proximity to the beach and local attractionsAccommodation Details:First Floor: Accommodates 8 guests with a king-suite, a twin room plus trundle, a bunk room, a full bathroom, and access to the outdoor patio and pool.Second Floor: Provides a comfortable living space for 4, with 2 guests in the primary suite and 2 Guests on the sleeper sofa, alongside the great room, kitchen, and an additional bathroom.Elevate Your Beach Experience - Reserve Your Beach Comforts EarlyEmbrace the luxury of hassle-free beach days at Longue Vue, where we prioritize your seaside relaxation. From March 1st through October 31st, Longue Vue Beach Services offers exclusive, premium beach chair and umbrella setups. Personal chairs and umbrellas are kindly not permitted during these times to ensure a seamless and elegant beachfront aesthetic. Rest assured, Longue Vue Beach Services guarantees the most competitive rates exclusively for homeowners, personal guests, and renters. For those enchanting evenings by the shore, inquire about organizing a beach bonfire through our community-approved vendor - a perfect way to create unforgettable memories under the stars.Community Guidelines to Enhance Your StayPlease note, the Longue Vue community maintains a serene and orderly environment by not permitting golf carts. This policy ensures the tranquility and safety of all our guests and residents, allowing everyone to enjoy the beauty of Longue Vue to the fullest.
